messages:
Maya: Folks  quick QBR on recurring incident patterns. Need owners & timelines to close loops.
Sam: I'll summarize counts from PM tags and surface repeats.
Priya: Customers are sensitive to instability; reducing variance > peak perf.
Evan: Ops note: 4 kernel-related rollouts correlated with cache eviction spikes.
Rachel: SRE: detection lag ~20m avg; alerts are too lenient and some signals missing.
Sam: Top categories (this quarter): cache-eviction (6), kernel/driver (4), runtime OOM (3), auth flaps (2).
Maya: For each, list owner, remediation, estimate, blockers. keep proposals pragmatic.
Evan: I'll own kernel rollout policy: staged canaries + soft rollback + preflight checks. est 3w.
Rachel: I'll add a synthetic cache-pressure probe and tighten alert thresholds. est 10d.
Priya: I'll take auth flaps: triage logs, hotfix PR, and config drift automation work. 2w hotfix, 4w automation.
Sam: Runtime OOMs need ML-eng + infra. short-term: reduce default batch sizes, add memory telemetry. est 2w mitigation, 6w allocator patch.
Maya: Drafting action items now. Call out success criteria and how we measure regression.
Sam: Actions:
- Evan -> rollout & rollback automation + preflight (due 2027-05-22)
- Rachel -> cache probe & alert tuning + testscript (due 2027-05-07)
- Priya -> auth triage + hotfix PR (due 2027-05-12)
- Priya+ML-eng -> runtime OOM mitigation plan (due 2027-05-19)
- Sam -> synthesis doc + conservative impact estimates (due 2027-04-29)
Maya: Include estimated monthly incidents avoided and expected SLO improvement in the PM.
oncall-bot: New ticket PM-2027-052 created ("Recurring incident QBR May"). Creator: Sam.
Sam: I'll attach a verification checklist: success metrics, monitoring queries, rollback criteria.
Maya: Let's run a recurring 30m monthly sync: first meeting 2027-05-25.
Rachel: I'll open the alerting PR after CI passes.
Evan: I'll begin the rollout test harness and compatibility checks.
oncall-bot: Reminder scheduled for 2027-05-20 for follow-ups.
